{{Quote|The Jedi Order was founded twenty-five thousand years ago by a group of beings who were strong with the Force. Before the Jedi Order, such Force-sensitive beings were isolated instead of united. Some were regarded as wizards. Others as demons. There were not many. Nearly all were considered unique on their own worlds. They were strong, powerful individuals. Free to live and die as they wished. But the Jedi Order changed all that.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], to [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]|<ref name="TWoDM">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref>}}
